verdict.rationale: Devin's entire product model is delegating coding tasks to a built-in AI agent — via chat, Slack/Teams tagging, CLI, or API — and this is extensively documented and corroborated by real-world usage reports (including critical ones describing actual delegated sessions). Community evidence shows the delegation model works in practice, though with caveats around needing supervision and occasional inefficiency. Missing for 10: independent benchmark of task success rate, and more balanced/positive third-party validation beyond one critical HN thread.
